A new statewide survey of 1,217 likely voters ranks Trump’s job disapproval at 53% compared to 46% who approve, a new low in Arkansas for the usually popular president. The Talk Business & Politics-Hendrix College Poll was conducted Aug. 11-12, 2026. The questions asked include:

Q: Do you approve or disapprove of the job Donald Trump is doing as president? [...] That strong disapproval of the president is driving pressure downward into races as GOP candidates are currently on the wrong side of Independent voters.

METHODOLOGY

results.content:
July 28, 2026

Americans' approval of Donald Trump's job performance continues to decline, according to the July 25 - 27 Economist / YouGov Poll. 34% of U.S. adult citizens strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, tied for a record low for either Trump term, while a record 62% disapprove. That's a net job approval of -28, also a record low.
